status: Research candidates and rejections; global calibration unaccepted

upperBodyPair.scope: Conditional relative-pose evidence. Detector counts, spacing and low epipolar error are not a metric survey or whole-reference acceptance.

primaryJointBundle.reason: Crop-boundary solution and independent turret residuals remain unresolved. No turret motion is inferred from these residuals.

frontImage1.reason: Its unknown focal length changes substantially between training subsets; unconverged bundle trials and a radial-bound rigid fit are not calibration evidence.

trackWidthGauge.reason: The lower crop includes repeated spokes and tread features. Physical endpoint identities and the full-width section remain unverified; detector rejection is not proof that every lower feature contradicts the pose.

ventGaugeRegistration.reason: Authored vent length is not an independent museum measurement. The chosen side-wall normal is not established as the vehicle transverse axis. Registered plane offset and clipped actual-model render are inconsistent; do not adopt this camera or use it to deform the vehicle.

lineCandidates.reason: Coarse frame corners, bent cast-tread edges and distinct vent hood/louver edges must not be silently treated as one exact parallel/orthogonal line system.

next: Establish a physical transverse direction or an independently checked turret axis; do not equate a side armor plane normal with an axle direction without evidence.
Audit the remaining primary/2022 physical identities and test stereo intrinsic/crop sensitivity before accepting the three-view pose.
Establish a genuine164mm full-track-width gauge with identified endpoints and section uncertainty; reject authored vent-length or front-fender-tip scale substitutions.
Only then revise the global comparison camera and whole-body geometry; final PBR/replay and the game derivative still follow gray acceptance.
